{{Quote|Kinyov is mostly desert and was sparsely inhabited during the initial Argazdan attacks, which is why it did not get bombed from orbit like Frezen, New Shallos, and other major settlements.|Tash Arranda, ''Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd, Or: What I Did On My Inter-Term Break''|<ref name="Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd" />}}
'''Kinyov''' was a sparsely populated and largely desert province on the [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] homeworld of [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]]. During the opening stages of the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]], Lorrdian refugees fleeing from other more populated parts of the planet fled to Kinyov. However, they were rounded up by [[Argazdan Redoubt]] forces and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]]. Its capital [[Qatamer]] became the headquarters of the [[Myrialites|Myrialite]] military occupation and slaving operations.<ref name="Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd" />
